bio: Every neighborhood deserves a reliable hotspot that cooks, pours and serves with remarkable ease. Dufferin Grove has this in Giulietta, a stylish (but not too stylish) Italian looker by Chef Rob Rossi. Even if you don’t live nearby, this talented team treats every guest like a long-time VIP. And the food? This is cooking that comforts, thanks to a kitchen that makes the most out of every dish on the menu. Yellowfin tuna crudo with bergamot marmalade is a vibrant way to begin before moving into heartier dishes. A diner might attempt ordering both the ricotta agnolotti with morels as well as the mafalde with veal cheek ragu, but don't forget pizza. Charred, puffy and dressed with smart ingredients, the savory pie is greedily delicious....
